newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel sees overreaction on forex markets.
newsitem.headline: Waigel sees overreaction on forex markets.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Tuesday Germany wants a strong deutschemark and that he believed the dollar and pound's strength against the mark was an overreaction by the market.
Waigel said Germany stood by previous agreements on foreign exchange rates within the Group of Seven (G7) industrial nations.
"We are interested in a strong deutschemark," Waigel said, adding "we are in contact with our partners."
He was speaking at a news conference in Berlin during a visit to the city of the leadership of his Christian Social Union (CSU) party.
Asked about the strength of the pound and the dollar at the moment, Waigel said "I think what's happening at the moment is an overreaction of the markets."
The dollar has lingered near six-year peaks against the mark and the pound hit the highest level since October 1990 against the mark on Monday.
